title: Manual
subtitle: Everything you need to get the most out of Forge — step by step.
footer_help: Can't find what you need? Email aafonsodias@gmail.com — I read every message.

start.title: Get started
start.intro: In 5 minutes you have your account ready and your first client filling an intake.

steps.p: At /auth, sign up with email + password or Google. Confirm the email to unlock the app.
Your hub: active clients, recent plans, and the status of each (draft, ready, in progress).
Clients → "Add client". Name is enough — the rest fills from the intake.
On the client card, copy the intake link and send it. The client fills it on their phone; you receive everything structured.

intake.title: Intake & Brief
intake.intro: The intake is the client's answers. The Brief is the professional reading of those answers — it feeds the whole plan.

steps.p: Goals, history, equipment, injuries, PAR-Q+. The client does this alone — 4–7 minutes.
At /plans/{id}/brief you review what the AI extracted: primary goal, emphasis, training band, red flags. Adjust anything.
The amber number ⓘ next to "Brief" is red flags (pain, recent injury, contraindication). Read them before approving.
When the brief reflects the client, approve to unlock the Blueprint.

plan.title: Blueprint, Microcycle & Progressions
plan.intro: Where the training is designed. Three stages, from structure to detail.

steps.p: Defines the shape of the mesocycle: number of weeks, days per week, focus per day (push, pull, lower, full, etc.).
Exercise-by-exercise detail of Day 1. You approve Day 1 — the "quality gate" — and the AI generates the rest at the same level.
Once all days are ready, the "Approve microcycle" button turns emerald. Click it for the AI to propose W2–W4 progressions.
You see weekly deltas (+kg, +rep, +RPE). Conservative > aggressive. Approve and the plan is ready for the client to train.

logs.title: Training logs
logs.intro: The client logs each session. You see everything in real time.

steps.p: Each client has a stable link (/log/{token}) you can save in their contact. Works on any phone.
On each set, log load and reps. Optionally RPE (0–10). RPE-less also works.
Only enables once at least one set is logged — prevents marking empty days by mistake.
Printable PDF for those who prefer paper at the gym. Bring the sheet, write by hand, photograph it and the app reads it back.

feedback.title: Reading feedback
feedback.intro: The app isn't just logging — it's a continuous improvement loop.

steps.p: Emerald = ready / done. Amber = attention (red flag, exceeding RPE). Red = error / critical drift. Grey = neutral / in progress.
Shows cumulative change W1 → W4. If the line stalls for 2 weeks, consider desensitisation (deload or exercise swap).
Conservative: if the client hits the RPE target 2 sessions in a row, raise next week's delta. If they miss, hold or back off.
Based on logs, generate the next week's sheet (soon — full loop automation). For now, edit the microcycle manually.
1 finalized training plan. Enough to validate if Forge fits your workflow.
